# Dataset preperation

## Import and save dataset with three gradients and network labels

```{r}
# import the raw dataset
raw_data <- read.csv(file.path(tables_dir, "dispersion_gradients_parcel_labels_iv.csv"))

# save the dataset
pc_write_csv(raw_data, file.path(tables_dir, "dispersion_posthoc_gradients_parcel_labels_iv.csv"))
```


## Calculate the centroid (mean of each network) along each gradient

```{r}
# Calculate centroid per participant per network per gradient
centroids <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(NECOS_ID, X7networks, scan, headmotion) %>%
  summarise(centroid_V1 = mean(V1),
            centroid_V2 = mean(V2),
            centroid_V3 = mean(V3),
            stress = first(stress)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Output the centroids dataset
centroids

```


## Create a dataset with Euclidean distances between the network centroids

```{r}
# Group by NECOS_ID, scan, and stress, and calculate the Euclidean distance between each pair of networks per gradient
euclidean_distances_per_gradient <- centroids %>%
  group_by(NECOS_ID, scan, stress, headmotion) %>%
  summarise(
    distance_default_control_v1 = sqrt(sum((centroid_V1[X7networks == "Default"] - centroid_V1[X7networks == "Control"])^2)),
    distance_default_salience_v1 = sqrt(sum((centroid_V1[X7networks == "Default"] - centroid_V1[X7networks == "Salience / Ventral Attn"])^2)),
    distance_control_salience_v1 = sqrt(sum((centroid_V1[X7networks == "Control"] - centroid_V1[X7networks == "Salience / Ventral Attn"])^2)),
    # Distance calculation for centroid_V2
    distance_default_control_v2 = sqrt(sum((centroid_V2[X7networks == "Default"] - centroid_V2[X7networks == "Control"])^2)),
    distance_default_salience_v2 = sqrt(sum((centroid_V2[X7networks == "Default"] - centroid_V2[X7networks == "Salience / Ventral Attn"])^2)),
    distance_control_salience_v2 = sqrt(sum((centroid_V2[X7networks == "Control"] - centroid_V2[X7networks == "Salience / Ventral Attn"])^2)),
    # Distance calculation for centroid_V3
    distance_default_control_v3 = sqrt(sum((centroid_V3[X7networks == "Default"] - centroid_V3[X7networks == "Control"])^2)),
    distance_default_salience_v3 = sqrt(sum((centroid_V3[X7networks == "Default"] - centroid_V3[X7networks == "Salience / Ventral Attn"])^2)),
    distance_control_salience_v3 = sqrt(sum((centroid_V3[X7networks == "Control"] - centroid_V3[X7networks == "Salience / Ventral Attn"])^2))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Output the euclidean_distances_per_gradient dataset
euclidean_distances_per_gradient


# Splitting the dataset into three based on centroid type
euclidean_distances_V1 <- euclidean_distances_per_gradient %>%
  select(NECOS_ID, scan, stress, headmotion, starts_with("distance_default_control_v1"), starts_with("distance_default_salience_v1"), starts_with("distance_control_salience_v1"))

euclidean_distances_V2 <- euclidean_distances_per_gradient %>%
  select(NECOS_ID, scan, stress, headmotion, starts_with("distance_default_control_v2"), starts_with("distance_default_salience_v2"), starts_with("distance_control_salience_v2"))

euclidean_distances_V3 <- euclidean_distances_per_gradient %>%
  select(NECOS_ID, scan, stress, headmotion, starts_with("distance_default_control_v3"), starts_with("distance_default_salience_v3"), starts_with("distance_control_salience_v3"))

# Output the datasets
euclidean_distances_V1
euclidean_distances_V2
euclidean_distances_V3


```


# LMM models 

```{r}
library(afex)

# Define the LMM formulas for each dependent variable
formulas_V1 <- c(
  "distance_default_control_v1 ~ scan * stress + headmotion + (1|NECOS_ID)",
  "distance_default_salience_v1 ~ scan * stress + headmotion + (1|NECOS_ID)",
  "distance_control_salience_v1 ~ scan * stress + headmotion + (1|NECOS_ID)"
)

formulas_V2 <- c(
  "distance_default_control_v2 ~ scan * stress + headmotion + (1|NECOS_ID)",
  "distance_default_salience_v2 ~ scan * stress + headmotion + (1|NECOS_ID)",
  "distance_control_salience_v2 ~ scan * stress + headmotion + (1|NECOS_ID)"
)

formulas_V3 <- c(
  "distance_default_control_v3 ~ scan * stress + headmotion + (1|NECOS_ID)",
  "distance_default_salience_v3 ~ scan * stress + headmotion + (1|NECOS_ID)",
  "distance_control_salience_v3 ~ scan * stress + headmotion + (1|NECOS_ID)"
)

# Fit the LMMs for each dataset
lmm_results_V1 <- lapply(formulas_V1, function(formula) mixed(as.formula(formula), data = euclidean_distances_V1))
lmm_results_V2 <- lapply(formulas_V2, function(formula) mixed(as.formula(formula), data = euclidean_distances_V2))
lmm_results_V3 <- lapply(formulas_V3, function(formula) mixed(as.formula(formula), data = euclidean_distances_V3))


# Output the LMM results for each dataset
list(lmm_results_V1, lmm_results_V2, lmm_results_V3)

```

# Save the uncorrected outputs as text files
```{r}
library(afex)

# Define the output directory
output_dir <- models_dir

# Create the directory if it doesn't exist
if (!file.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Save the summaries for each dataset
save_lmm_summary <- function(lmm_results, output_prefix) {
  for (i in seq_along(lmm_results)) {
    output_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_", i, ".txt"))
    cat(capture.output(summary(lmm_results[[i]])), file = output_path, sep = "\n")
  }
}

# Save summaries for each version
save_lmm_summary(lmm_results_V1, "lmm_summary_uncorrected_g1")
save_lmm_summary(lmm_results_V2, "lmm_summary_uncorrected_g2")
save_lmm_summary(lmm_results_V3, "lmm_summary_uncorrected_g3")


```

# Extract p-values, correct with FDR and save as a csv
```{r}
extract_p_values <- function(lmm_results) {
  if (!is.list(lmm_results)) {
    stop("Input must be a list.")
  }
  
  p_values_list <- lapply(lmm_results, function(model) {
    if (inherits(model, "mixed")) {
      # For mixed models from afex package
      interaction_p_value <- model$anova_table["scan:stress", "Pr(>F)"]
    } else if (inherits(model, "merMod")) {
      # For lmer models from lme4 package
      interaction_p_value <- summary(model)$coefficients["stress:scan", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else if (inherits(model, "anova")) {
      # For afex models
      interaction_p_value <- model["scan:stress"]
    } else {
      warning("Unrecognized model type:", class(model))
      interaction_p_value <- NA
    }
    return(interaction_p_value)
  })
  
  return(p_values_list)
}

# Extract and adjust p-values for each version
p_values_V1 <- extract_p_values(lmm_results_V1)
p_values_V2 <- extract_p_values(lmm_results_V2)
p_values_V3 <- extract_p_values(lmm_results_V3)

# Combine model formulas and p-values for all versions
all_model_formulas <- c(formulas_V1, formulas_V2, formulas_V3)
all_p_values <- c(p_values_V1, p_values_V2, p_values_V3)

# Create a dataframe to store the model formulas and p-values
all_model_p_values <- data.frame(
  Model = all_model_formulas,
  P_Value = all_p_values
)

# Adjust p-values for false discovery rate (FDR) across all models
all_model_p_values$P_Value_p_adjusted <- p.adjust(all_p_values, method = "fdr")


# Save the results to a CSV file
output_csv <- file.path(models_dir, "dispersion_posthoc_p_values.csv")
write.csv(all_model_p_values, file = output_csv, row.names = FALSE)

```
